description: HydroFunctions is the Python package maintained by its hydrology community for retrieving and exploring USGS water observations. It queries NWIS using site identifiers, administrative areas or bounding boxes and preserves units, missing-data indicators and source metadata. Outputs include pandas tables, JSON or dictionary representations, hydrographs, flow-duration plots and optional Parquet caches. Geographic coverage follows USGS stations, with time periods and sampling frequency selected through the source service. Public source and usage instructions are free under MIT. A limitation is that measurements and rating curves retain their original uncertainty and revision status, and software availability does not guarantee that a legacy service endpoint remains unchanged. The documentation's worked station example is not an independently checked current query. HydroFunctions can prepare boundary and validation series for water-infrastructure simulations such as Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). The README links a detailed user guide. No station observations or cached data files were downloaded.
